style_options.name: 现代简约

Quiet neutral contrast, discreet ceiling lights; avoid ornate mouldings, carved gilt furniture and decorative clutter.

style_options.name: 法式风格
style_options.description: Distinct residential French elegance: ivory panelled walls with delicate classical mouldings and cornice, herringbone oak floor, cream curved sofa with restrained carved frame, floral framed painting, oval-back dining chairs, graceful brass chandelier and fabric-shade lamp.
